conventions.coords: normalised [-1,1]; x right, y down; pixel centre j -> (j+0.5)/W*2-1
conventions.render: I(p) = sum_i color_i * exp(-0.5 (p-mu_i)^T Sigma_i^-1 (p-mu_i)); no opacity, no sorting
conventions.shape: (log s1, log s2, theta); Sigma = R(theta) diag(s1^2, s2^2) R(theta)^T; theta in [-pi/2, pi/2)
conventions.order: slot k started at grid cell k (row-major, sqrt(N) x sqrt(N)) for every image
conventions.alive: False = unused Gaussian, reset to its slot with colour 0 (renders nothing)
